# contentful_taxonomy_concept (Resource)

Manages a Contentful taxonomy concept in an organization, including its labels, notes, and relationships to other concepts. Assign concepts to Entries through their `metadata.concepts` attribute.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "contentful_taxonomy_concept" "furniture" {
  organization_id = var.contentful_organization_id
  concept_id      = "furniture"

  pref_label = {
    "en-US" = "Furniture"
  }

  alt_labels = {
    "en-US" = ["Furnishings"]
  }

  notations = ["FURNITURE"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `concept_id` (String) ID to assign to the taxonomy concept. Must contain 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, dots, hyphens, or underscores. Changing this value replaces the resource.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization that owns the taxonomy concept. Changing this value replaces the resource.
- `pref_label` (Map of String) Preferred labels keyed by locale code, for example `{ "en-US" = "Furniture" }`.

### Optional

- `alt_labels` (Map of List of String) Alternative labels keyed by locale code, with a list of labels for each locale. Omission uses the Contentful value; an explicit empty collection clears it.
- `broader_concept_ids` (List of String) Ordered IDs of broader concepts. Omission uses the Contentful value; an explicit empty collection clears it.
- `change_note` (Map of String) Change notes keyed by locale code.
- `definition` (Map of String) Definitions keyed by locale code.
- `editorial_note` (Map of String) Editorial notes keyed by locale code.
- `example` (Map of String) Examples keyed by locale code.
- `hidden_labels` (Map of List of String) Hidden labels keyed by locale code, with a list of labels for each locale. Omission uses the Contentful value; an explicit empty collection clears it.
- `history_note` (Map of String) History notes keyed by locale code.
- `notations` (List of String) Ordered notation values. Omission uses the Contentful value; an explicit empty collection clears it.
- `note` (Map of String) Notes keyed by locale code.
- `related_concept_ids` (List of String) Ordered IDs of related concepts. Omission uses the Contentful value; an explicit empty collection clears it.
- `scope_note` (Map of String) Scope notes keyed by locale code.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `uri` (String) Nonempty URI identifying the concept.

### Read-Only

- `concept_scheme_ids` (Set of String) IDs of schemes containing the concept.
- `id` (String) Composite Terraform resource identifier in organization_id/concept_id form.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) Duration for the complete operation, including retries, for example `30s` or `5m`. Defaults to `2m`.
- `delete` (String) Includes retries and uses the duration saved in state (default `2m`, minimum provider timeout `10s`).
- `read` (String) Includes retries and uses the duration saved in state (default `2m`, minimum provider timeout `10s`).
- `update` (String) Duration for the complete operation, including retries, for example `30s` or `5m`. Defaults to `2m`.

## Import

### By identity (Terraform 1.12 or later)

```terraform
import {
  identity = {
    organization_id = var.contentful_organization_id
    concept_id      = "furniture"
  }
  to = contentful_taxonomy_concept.furniture
}
```

### By ID (Terraform 1.5 or later)

```terraform
import {
  id = "${var.contentful_organization_id}/furniture"
  to = contentful_taxonomy_concept.furniture
}
```

### From the command line

```shell
terraform import contentful_taxonomy_concept.furniture "$CONTENTFUL_ORGANIZATION_ID/furniture"
```
